purpose: Freeze the normalized per-Hero output shape that integrates the accepted Stage 5-5-1 canonical identity and Stage 5-5-2 display semantics without reopening source interpretation.

identity.nameKr: string; canonical reviewed Korean Hero name
identity.nameCn: string; canonical reviewed Chinese Hero name
identity.nameEn: string; canonical reviewed English Hero name

rarity.baseLabel: enum N|R|SR|SSR|LLR resolved from validated Rank mapping

factions.nameKr: string|null; presentation localization layer, null until accepted

cv.sourceValue: string; raw ConfigDataCharImageInfo.CVName preserved as-is, including ■■■■ for confirmed NONE cases
cv.nameKr: string|null; user-owned Korean localization, null until supplied

origin.nameKr: string|null; presentation localization layer, null until supplied
origin.category: enum ORIGINAL|MOBILE_ORIGINAL|COLLAB; presentation grouping derived from the accepted design rule

skins.order: integer; 1-based order derived only from ConfigDataHeroInfo.Skins_ID[] array position
skins.nameKr: string|null; presentation localization layer, null until supplied

acquisition.labelCn: string|null; 2=光之回响, 3=命运星织, 4=英雄皮肤商店

ORIGINAL.meaning: Langrisser I-V, Reincarnation, Millennium WS, Millennium DC

MOBILE_ORIGINAL.meaning: Langrisser Mobile original story groups I-IV

originCategoryRule.completenessRule: The three category sets must be disjoint and their union must equal production IDs 1-32.

normalizationRules: Exactly 267 output records are emitted, one per canonical heroId.
heroId is the only relational join key. Names are display values only.
identity stays nested and is copied only from the canonical identity master.
rarity.baseLabel is the base Rank-derived rarity only. SP must not overwrite it.
The design label SSR(1-person-limited) is not a base rarity value and must not be inferred in Stage 5-5-3; summon/banner semantics own that distinction.
factions is deterministic by ascending factionId for serialization only; this sort is not asserted as gameplay display semantics.
CV sourceValue is never auto-transliterated. For heroIds 99235, 99236 and 99276, cv.state is NONE even though sourceValue is preserved as ■■■■.
CV source strings containing '&' remain one sourceValue and are not split in this stage.
origin contains exactly one productionId per Hero and derives category only through originCategoryRule.
artwork.sourceAssetPath is a source asset locator, not a browser URL. Web asset resolution belongs to the asset/export layer.
skins preserves Skins_ID[] source order exactly and writes order as arrayPosition+1.
Heroes with no skin refs emit skins: [].
Skin sourceImagePath/sourceSpinePath are source asset locators, not assumed public URLs.
Missing GetPathType emits acquisition.state=UNENCODED with typeCode/labelCn/labelKr all null.
GetPathType 2/3/4 emits acquisition.state=ENCODED and the frozen labels from Stage 5-5-2.
Do not use HeroSkinInfo.Score, skin ID sorting, store UISort, or acquisition type to reorder skins.

ownershipBoundaries.sp: Stage 5-4 remains the authority for SP existence, SP illustration switching, SP missions and SP-specific page data. Stage 5-5-3 does not synthesize SP into rarity or skins.
ownershipBoundaries.soloLimitedSSR: Banner/summon data owns the one-person-limited SSR distinction. Stage 5-5-3 stores base rarity SSR only until that separate source is joined by a later composition layer.
ownershipBoundaries.combat: Stage 4 remains the authority for stats/jobs/skills/talent and is not embedded here.
ownershipBoundaries.bonds: Stage 5-1 remains the authority for bond data and is not embedded here.
ownershipBoundaries.soldiers: Stage 5-3 remains the authority for usable-Soldier data and is not embedded here.
ownershipBoundaries.assetExport: This contract stores authoritative source asset paths. Extraction, conversion and web-serving paths belong to a separate asset pipeline.

localizationPolicy.canonicalHeroNames: nameKr/nameCn/nameEn are already reviewed canonical identity fields and are emitted directly.
localizationPolicy.cv: cv.nameKr remains null until the user supplies Korean voice-actor localization.
localizationPolicy.origin: origin.nameKr remains null until an accepted Korean work-title dictionary is supplied.
localizationPolicy.factions: factions[].nameKr remains null until the Korean faction-label dictionary is explicitly accepted.
localizationPolicy.skins: skins[].nameKr remains null until a Korean skin-name dictionary is supplied.
localizationPolicy.rule: Localization gaps do not block structural generation; they remain explicit nulls rather than synthesized strings.

requiredValidation.skinCoverage: Every referenced skin must resolve to one HeroSkinInfo row and one CharImageSkinResourceInfo row.
requiredValidation.skinOrder: For every Hero, emitted skins[].skinId sequence must exactly equal HeroInfo.Skins_ID[] after the validated omitted-empty normalization.
requiredValidation.acquisitionGap: Exactly the current source-defined UNENCODED set may remain null; Stage 5-5-3 must not fabricate missing acquisition data.

prohibitions: Do not flatten all values into a UI-specific string object; preserve semantic groups.
Do not duplicate Stage 4/5-1/5-3/5-4 owned data in this dataset.
Do not rewrite base rarity as SP or SSR(1-person-limited).
Do not replace source asset paths with guessed filenames or URLs.
Do not translate CV, faction, origin or skin labels automatically where localization is explicitly deferred.
Do not fill the 176 missing GetPathType rows by inference.
completionRule: The Stage 5-5-3 output structure is fixed when this contract is accepted. The next action is to build data/hero-page-stage5-5-3.v1.json for all 267 Heroes exactly against this record shape and run full contract validation.
nextAction: Generate and validate the 267-record Stage 5-5-3 integrated output without changing this schema unless a proven source contradiction is found.
